title: Medical, Evacuation and Accident Benefits: Travel Protection Plans Annex
content:
This annex states, for each Travel Protection Plans plan, the emergency medical benefit limit per insured traveller, the deductible withheld from each emergency medical settlement, the emergency dental benefit limit per insured traveller, the emergency evacuation and repatriation limit per insured traveller, and the accidental death and dismemberment benefit per insured traveller. Every figure is in USD and every one of them is stated per insured traveller.

| Plan | Emergency medical | Medical deductible | Emergency dental | Evacuation and repatriation | Accidental death and dismemberment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 25000.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 100000.00 | 10000.00 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 50000.00 | 150.00 | 750.00 | 250000.00 | 25000.00 |
| TripGuard Plus | 100000.00 | 100.00 | 1000.00 | 500000.00 | 50000.00 |
| TripGuard Premier | 250000.00 | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1000000.00 | 100000.00 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 250000.00 | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1000000.00 | 100000.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 150000.00 | 100.00 | 1000.00 | 500000.00 | 50000.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 500000.00 | 0.00 | 2500.00 | 1000000.00 | 150000.00 |

Note (i): the medical deductible is the amount withheld from an emergency medical settlement on that plan. It falls as the plan rises, from 250.00 on Trip Basics Essential through 150.00 on Trip Basics Standard to 100.00 on TripGuard Plus and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and stands at 0.00 on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

Note (ii): because each figure above is a benefit per insured traveller, a certificate naming several travellers carries the scheduled amount for each of them. Hypothetically, on TripGuard Plus the emergency medical figure is 100000.00 for one named traveller and the same 100000.00 again for a second named traveller.

Note (iii): Cancel For Any Reason Elite carries the same medical, dental, evacuation and accident figures as TripGuard Premier; the two plans differ elsewhere, not in this annex.
